repetition.text: A dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures, all of them clipped out of hedge by somebody with a steady hand and an unsteady mind. They have not been clipped lately, and the dog in particular has grown a little past itself. You have the feeling they were not standing quite like that when you came in.
The first letter is a capital E. The rest is too small to read.
